implementation.summary: Added typed AC1024 source parsing with exact bounded body completion, custom-class dispatch and raw companion retention; implemented a narrow DXF reader/writer profile; and connected source dictionary admission to owner/block-reference output checks. The DXF generic dynamic-block dispatcher explicitly excludes this record so its typed parser runs.
implementation.profileLimits: Output requires AC1024, complete body, valid nonzero flag/block handle, one owner reactor, no extension dictionary, APPDATA, XDATA or DataStorage. The source-graph planner additionally requires exact source class/type, one matching block record and definition, and the canonical dictionary entry.
implementation.failureBehavior: The record writer rejects incomplete or out-of-profile bodies transactionally. The focused selector checks destination preservation and same-writer corrected retry. Physical source output remains strict and unqualified until staged OBJECTS inspection succeeds.
